extracted.intended_audience: researchers, academics, and early-career scholars who want training in peer review (both prospective reviewers and authors navigating peer review).
extracted.subtask_description: An online course/syllabus covering fundamentals and practical skills for participating in peer review: what peer review is, how the process works, how to write reviews, ethical responsibilities, specialty article types, and how authors should respond to reviews and interact with editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certified Peer Reviewer Course / Certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete our 'Certified Peer Reviewer Course' and publicly demonstrate your expertise as a referee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course includes assessment and multiple modules; certification is presented as a way to demonstrate referee expertise publicly.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is peer review? Why peer review?
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory material explaining what peer review is and why it exists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foundational rationale and purposes of peer review (context-setting for subsequent practical guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Models of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of different models of peer review (e.g., single-blind, double-blind, open).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps reviewers and authors understand how different review models affect processes and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: The typical peer review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of the typical sequence of steps in peer review from submission to decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers milestones and what to expect at each stage of the process.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to get involved
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for researchers on how to become a peer reviewer and get involved with journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical steps for recruitment and engagement as a reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: I just got a review invite, what’s next?
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice on immediate actions and considerations after receiving an invitation to review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes how to assess suitability/conflicts and how to accept or decline professionally.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to write a helpful peer review report
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction on composing a review report that is useful to editors and authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers characteristics of a helpful report (clarity, constructiveness, actionable feedback); module duration: 25 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: The comments to editors and decision recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on what to include in confidential comments to the editor and how to formulate decision recommendations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between public reviewer comments for authors and private comments to editors, and explains making recommendation choices (accept/revise/reject).

rubrics_metrics.name: How to peer review a review article
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific guidance for reviewing review/survey articles (different expectations than original research articles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses criteria specific to review articles such as coverage, synthesis, balance, and up-to-dateness; module duration: 37 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: What next? (follow-up for reviewers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice for reviewers about next steps after submitting a review (e.g., tracking decisions, future involvement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical follow-up and ongoing reviewer development.

rubrics_metrics.name: A practical guide to navigating the peer review process
rubrics_metrics.description: A consolidated, practical webinar covering navigating the entire peer review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One-hour practical guide intended to help both authors and reviewers manage the process effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do I review a Data Article?
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance specific to reviewing Data Articles (data descriptions, reproducibility, metadata, access).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers format-specific expectations for data-focused submissions; module duration: 22 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generative AI in research evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion of the role and implications of generative AI in research evaluation and peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses how AI tools may affect evaluating manuscripts and ethical/quality considerations; module duration: 1 h.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building trust and engagement in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies and practices to foster trust and engagement among reviewers, authors, and editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes community- and process-level practices to strengthen peer review; module duration: 1 h.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on promoting and understanding diversity considerations in peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers diversity-related goals, biases, and inclusion strategies; module duration: 1 h.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why get involved in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Motivations and benefits for researchers to participate in peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains professional and community reasons to review; module duration: 45 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics responsibilities for peer reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical responsibilities and expected conduct for peer reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers confidentiality, conflicts of interest, plagiarism detection, and fair, unbiased assessment; module duration: 32 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognizing peer reviewers: A webinar to celebrate editors and researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion on recognition and appreciation mechanisms for reviewers and editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explores recognition programs and their role in reviewer motivation; module duration: 46 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and practices for increasing transparency in peer review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses open peer review models, data/publication of reviews, and related trade-offs; module duration: 56 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to review a manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical, step-by-step instruction on reviewing a standard manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers assessing novelty, methodology, interpretation, presentation, and making recommendations; interactive course, 40 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10 tips for writing a truly terrible review
rubrics_metrics.description: A reverse-psychology module listing anti-patterns that produce unhelpful or harmful reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights what not to do (uses negative examples to teach good practice); webinar, 52 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to become a reviewer and what do editors expect?
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance on becoming a reviewer and editors' expectations of reviewer contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains recruitment paths, desired reviewer skills, timeliness, and quality expectations; webinar, 56 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: How reviewers become editors
rubrics_metrics.description: Career pathway content explaining how active reviewers may progress to editorial roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes criteria and activities that lead to editorial responsibilities; webinar, 55 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to respond to reviewers' comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for authors on responding to reviewer comments to keep a submission moving through the process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how to prepare response letters, address critiques, and negotiate revisions; webinar, 37 m.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do editors look at your paper?
rubrics_metrics.description: Editor-perspective guidance describing what editors focus on when they evaluate submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps authors and reviewers understand editorial priorities and decision-making; webinar, 31 m.
